content.short: Resonance Security provides cybersecurity Aggregation Software and Concierge for End to End Cybersecurity Products and Services.
content.description: Resonance Security helps projects move beyond checkbox cybersecurity reviews by guiding them through end-to-end security activities across their entire lifecycle. Our software uses a proprietary scoring algorithm to identify, prioritize, and address each project's specific security needs, so teams can stay ahead of risks rather than chasing audits. It also features an AI chatbot, a responsive support team, and proactive notifications to keep clients informed, coordinated, and confident as remediation work progresses.
